def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    upper, lower = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    u2, u4 = sum(row.count(2) for row in upper), sum(row.count(4) for row in upper)
    l2, l4 = sum(row.count(2) for row in lower), sum(row.count(4) for row in lower)
    # The relative vertical-bar lengths select one of the two colors.
    if (u2, u4, l2, l4) in {(1, 2, 2, 2), (3, 2, 4, 4)}:
        color = 4
    else:
        color = 2
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
